content.heading: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, etc.
content.text: Article 19(1) guarantees to citizens the freedoms of speech and expression, peaceful assembly, association, movement, residence, and practice of any profession or carrying on any occupation, trade or business. Clauses (2) to (6) permit reasonable restrictions only on the grounds specified in those clauses. Canonical: provision:india:constitution-art-19.
